description.value: Grab and Go is a North Vancouver Persian restaurant serving freshly made, never-frozen dishes daily from its Lonsdale Avenue location. Founded in 2019, the fast-casual concept has grown to two Lower Mainland locations. Cyclists on Lonsdale will find a convenient stop for a filling, made-fresh meal with online ordering available.
